Системный сервер Android падает на старт: The Android system server crashes at startup; the device bootloops after the logo.
Причина почти всегда в несовместимых пра: The cause is almost always incompatible framework edits or system APK signature conflicts. Roll back recent changes to system/framework, make sure all system APKs are signed with one key (APK Kitchen → 'Build & Sign'), and when porting — that boot.img and fstab are taken from the base (Device → Porting).
Zygote не может стартовать — повреждён и: Zygote cannot start — the framework is corrupted or incompatible (boot.oat / framework.jar do not match the kernel or boot.img).
Проверьте, что boot.img строго из базы,: Make sure boot.img comes strictly from the base, not the donor. If you moved the framework — restore the original boot-classpath. Deodexed APKs must be built with the same bootclasspath as the firmware framework.
SELinux запрещает процессам доступ к рес: SELinux denies processes access to resources. Mass denials after porting break HALs: camera, audio, sensors, fingerprint.
Соберите все denial и сгенерируйте прави: Collect all denials and generate sepolicy rules via audit2allow, adding them to the device sepolicy. To quickly verify SELinux is the cause, temporarily switch it to permissive: Patches → Boot & Kernel → 'SELinux Permissive', repack boot and flash.
Проверка целостности раздела не проходит: Partition integrity verification fails after modifying system/vendor — boot is blocked or the device bootloops.
Отключите флаги verify/avb в fstab: Патч: Disable verify/avb flags in fstab: Patches → Boot & Kernel → 'Disable DM-Verity & AVB'. Then flash vbmeta with verification disabled: Patches → VBMeta & AVB → 'Disable Verity & Verification'.
Бинарник или HAL не может загрузиться —: A binary or HAL cannot load — vendor/lib(64) is missing .so files, or the VNDK version does not match the required one.
Перенесите недостающие библиотеки из баз: Transfer the missing libraries from the base: Device → Porting → 'Sync HAL drivers (vendor/lib/hw)'. Compare the VNDK versions of base and port in the comparison table — if they differ, complete vendor with the base library set.
Сервис камеры падает или не находит HAL: The camera service crashes or cannot find the HAL — camera apps show a black screen or force close.
Перенесите из базы camera HAL: vendor/li: Transfer the camera HAL from the base: vendor/lib/hw/camera.*, vendor/lib64/hw/camera.* and related camera blobs (vendor/lib/camera/). Check SELinux denials for cameraserver.
Аудиосервер не может открыть аппаратный: The audio server cannot open the hardware module — sound disappears, calls and players hang.
Перенесите из базы audio.primary.*.so, a: Transfer from the base: audio.primary.*.so, the audio_policy configuration (vendor/etc/audio_policy_configuration.xml) and mixer_paths*.xml.
Не работают акселерометр, гироскоп, датч: Accelerometer, gyroscope and proximity sensor don't work — no auto-rotation, screen doesn't turn off during calls.
Перенесите sensors.*.so и конфиги sensor: Transfer sensors.*.so and sensor configs from the base (vendor/lib/hw/, vendor/etc/sensors/).
Чип Wi-Fi/BT не получает прошивку — пере: The Wi-Fi/BT chip doesn't receive its firmware — the Wi-Fi/Bluetooth toggles won't turn on.
Перенесите радиомодули из базы: Устройст: Transfer the radio modules from the base: Device → Porting → 'Sync radio modules (vendor/firmware)'. Also check WCNSS_qcom_cfg.ini and permissions on /vendor/firmware.
Модем / RIL: нет сети, падение qcrild: Modem / RIL: no network, qcrild crash
Радиоинтерфейс не поднимается — нет SIM,: The radio interface doesn't come up — no SIM, mobile data and calls don't work.
Перенесите modem-прошивку (раздел modem: Transfer the modem firmware (modem partition / vendor/firmware) and RIL libraries (libril*, libqmi*) from the base. Make sure the persist and nvram partitions weren't wiped.
Файловая система раздела повреждена — ра: The partition's filesystem is corrupted — it mounts read-only or doesn't mount at all.
Пересоберите образ раздела: Распаковка/С: Rebuild the partition image: Unpack/Build → 'Build All'. Check that the built .img size doesn't exceed the partition size and that it's built with the same FS type (erofs/ext4) that fstab expects.
fs_mgr не может смонтировать разделы по: fs_mgr cannot mount partitions per fstab — boot stops at the logo.
Синхронизируйте fstab из базы: Устройств: Sync fstab from the base: Device → Porting → 'Sync fstab and mount points'. Check by-name paths and first_stage_mount flags.
init не находит скрипты или исполняемые: init cannot find scripts or service executables — HALs and daemons don't start after the transfer.
Проверьте vendor/etc/init/*.rc и vendor/: Check vendor/etc/init/*.rc and vendor/bin: when transferring HALs, copy the services' .rc files along with the binaries. Paths in .rc must match the actual file locations.
PackageManager: ошибки парсинга и подпис: PackageManager: APK parsing and signature errors
Пакетный менеджер отвергает APK: битый м: The package manager rejects the APK: a corrupted manifest after edits or a signature conflict with the already installed version.
Переподпишите изменённый APK тем же ключ: Re-sign the modified APK with the same key as the rest of the system: APK Kitchen → 'Build & Sign'. On signature conflict, remove the old version from /data or use a test key for the whole firmware.
Приложение падает с необработанным исклю: The app crashes with an unhandled exception. Common causes after modding: a removed resource in res, smali edits with wrong registers, a missing dependency.
Найдите имя пакета и первую строку стека: Find the package name and the first stack line (Caused by). If you edited smali — check the .locals count and register types. If you removed resources — restore them or fix references in public.xml. Rebuild and sign the APK in APK Kitchen.
GMS падает циклически — всплывают ошибки: GMS crashes in a loop — 'Google app has stopped' popups appear, battery drains.
Обновите или переустановите GApps под ну: Update or reinstall GApps for the correct Android version. For microG, enable signature spoofing in the framework (smali patch in services.jar).
Ядро убивает приложения из-за нехватки R: The kernel kills apps due to low RAM — freezes, launcher restarts, background task crashes.
Настройте zram и лимиты фоновых процессо: Tune zram and background process limits with build.prop tweaks: Patches → build.prop Tweaks → memory optimization presets. Remove heavy apps with the Debloater.
Срабатывает тепловая защита — частоты CP: Thermal protection kicks in — CPU/GPU frequencies drop, the device lags under load.
Это штатная защита, но агрессивные профи: This is normal protection, but aggressive profiles can be softened by editing thermal-*.conf in vendor/etc. Make sure that after porting the thermal engine comes from the base, not the donor.
Криптографические сервисы не работают —: Cryptographic services don't work — screen lock can't be set, fingerprints and encryption fail.
Перенесите keymaster/gatekeeper HAL из б: Transfer the keymaster/gatekeeper HAL from the base. If keystore data is corrupted after a firmware change — a data wipe will help.
Как снять logcat с устройства: How to capture logcat from a device
Базовый способ получить журнал Android O: The basic way to get the Android OS log: app crashes, service errors and SystemUI.
Лог ядра: старт драйверов, SELinux на ра: Kernel log: driver startup, early-stage SELinux, FS and hardware errors. Needed for the First Stage steps on the boot map.
При бутлупе устройство перезагружается р: During a bootloop the device reboots before you can grab the log. Enabled logpersistd writes the log to disk and survives reboots.
Если устройство умирает до старта ADB, п: If the device dies before ADB starts, the last kernel lines are saved in pstore. After rebooting into recovery you can pull them and see the bootloop cause.
Hardcore-вариант для отладки First Stage: Hardcore option for First Stage debugging: kernel output to the serial port before display init. Requires a UART adapter and board testpoint soldering.
Строит таймлайн старта процессов: видно,: Builds a process startup timeline: you can see which stage slows down or hangs the OS boot.
